read.en: Bloom Energy fell 1.7% on Nov 19 to $168.11 after opening at $181 and spiking to $187, a $166.17–187.00 range. It is below the 5-day ($176.4), 10-day ($184.6) and 30-day ($210.1), all falling, and the 100-day ($231.3, falling) and 200-day ($223.9, rising). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 17, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($208.53), and RSI is 38.0.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月19日下跌 1.7%，收于 $168.11，开盘 $181 后一度冲高至 $187，盘中区间 $166.17–187.00。股价位于 5 日（$176.4）、10 日（$184.6）和 30 日均线（$210.1）下方，三者均在下行，也低于 100 日（$231.3，下行）和 200 日均线（$223.9，上行）。MACD 自 11月17日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$208.53），RSI 为 38.0。

read.en: No level changed on the close: the $187 high was rejected above the 10-day, and the $166.17 low dipped under $167.4 but the close held the $167.4–168.8 band. Resistance is $173.2–173.9 (Nov 6 and 17 closes, Nov 16 low), then $176.4–177.3 (5-day, Nov 16 close) and $184.6–187 (10-day, Nov 10 close, Nov 19 high). Support is $166.2–167.5, then $162.9 (Nov 17 low) and $156 (Nov 5 low). A close above $173.9 would target $177; below $166.2, $162.9.

r.en: Nov 6 close $173.24; Nov 17 close $173.46; Nov 16 low $173.90

s.en: Nov 19 low $166.17; Nov 18 low $167.36; Nov 5 close $167.52
